provenance.paper: Quinlan, J. R. (1990). Learning logical definitions from relations.
provenance.locus: Section 3 (the FOIL algorithm: information gain t·(log2(p1/(p1+n1)) − log2(p0/(p0+n0)))); the daughter/parent family relation example used throughout the ILP literature for FOIL.
provenance.notes: The classic daughter learning task: from parent/2 and female/1 background facts, FOIL must induce daughter(X,Y) :- female(X), parent(Y,X). With head variables V0=X, V1=Y the learned body must equal {female(V0), parent(V1,V0)} as a set (literal order is the greedy gain order).

expected.head: daughter(V0,V1)
expected.notes: One clause covers both positives and excludes all four negatives; body compared as a set.
